storyQualifications.fact: The two Silver Surfer launches form one Slott and Michael Allred project. The introductory Point One selection is one story; the checklist includes the whole anthology.
The two specified She-Hulk launches are selected; Peter David's later run is separate. Omnibus extras can have shared credits.
Brand New Day is multiwriter. Include only issues with an individually pinned Slott writer credit, including an issue whose Slott contribution is a supplemental story.
The source selects Superior Spider-Man #1-31 and Amazing Spider-Man #698-700, not additional annuals or other omnibus contributions.
The 2014 run is a shared Slott and Christos Gage selection. Unnamed Conway decimal issues are not added.
The 2015 launch is a Slott-led and Gage-shared selection; separate decimal issues and annuals are not added.

The opening Fantastic Four collection is not the whole run. The source selects material from #12, and supplementary stories have other writers; whole issues are included where the checklist cannot select stories.
The Mighty Avengers selection is a shared Slott and Gage collection, not a claim of exclusive Slott scripts. Requiem selects material from the whole included issue.
The Initiative selection has shared Slott and Gage writing; later Gage-led chapters are outside the source range.
The Thing and Spider-Man/Human Torch are the two bounded projects selected by the source.
Three later projects have no endpoints in the source; individually pinned issue credits and the recorded owner cutoff establish the proposed selection.
